mentions.name: Grovia
mentions.description: This project provides LoRa mesh farming data collection through a remote greenhouse monitor. It is a live, working setup deployed on the author's small farming plot and ready for the growing season, with future plans to add AI data tools and SaaS features.
mentions.audience: Personal use on the author's small farming plot
mentions.source_excerpt:
Grovia - Lora mesh farming data: https://github.com/benb0jangles/Remote-greenhouse-monitor

I hope to add ai data tools & saas, but really I'm just happy to have a running working live setup on my small farming plot ready for the growing season - https://benb0jangles.github.io/Remote-greenhouse-monitor/
